inspiration.observed_pattern: VAR_POP computes analytic population variance over grouped aggregate totals ordered by a reporting dimension.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored region with three monthly totals so the grouped running population variance remains observable without copying source data.

fixture_notes: Three monthly groups expose the singleton, two-value, and three-value running population variance calculations.
determinism_notes: All shipment rows, region codes, month numbers, grouping keys, frame ordering, and output ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE shipment_ledger (shipment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, month_no INT NOT NULL, net_amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT region_code, month_no, SUM(net_amount) AS monthly_total, VAR_POP(SUM(net_amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY month_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_variance FROM shipment_ledger GROUP BY region_code, month_no ORDER BY region_code, month_no
